exposure: continuous and repeated treatment with atosiban
outcome: operative delivery due to fetal distress
cohort: The study included 90 twin pregnancies diagnosed with threatened preterm labor.
finding: Continuous and repeated treatment with atosiban in twin pregnancies with threatened preterm labor effectively prolonged pregnancy, resulted in a later gestational age, and was associated with lower rates of operative delivery due to fetal distress and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Continuous and repeated atosiban treatment was associated with a lower proportion of cases requiring operative delivery due to fetal distress.
